simple.summary: רִיפָה (rîyphâh) means (only plural), grits (as pounded) First listed occurrence: 2Sam 17 19.

definitions.full: H7383. riphah [ רִיפָה ] noun [feminine] dubious; some grain or fruit (such as was spread out to dry (2 Samuel), and also pounded (Proverbs); ᵑ9 2Samuel as if drying barley groats , ᵐ5 L παλάθας cakes of preserved fruit , compare preparation of 'apricot-cheese' Wetzst ZPV xiv. 2 Nes Marg.18 , who cites also Almkvist Kl. Beltr. zur Lexicogr. des Vulgar Arabic Actes. 419 ); — plural absolute רִפוֺת 2Sam 17:19 , רִיפוֺת Prov 27:22 .
